data.name: Mark
data.gender_notes: Mark is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin Marcus, probably related to Mars, the Roman god of war. Its root is Latin Mars. Mark the Evangelist; the Gospel of Mark. Mark is a Latin name meaning “Warlike; dedicated to Mars”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mark expresses “Warlike; dedicated to Mars”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin Marcus, probably related to Mars, the Roman god of war.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mark total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

biblical_reference.note: The name Mark is associated with the apostle Saint Mark, the author of the second Gospel, and is mentioned in the New Testament as the companion of Saint Paul and Saint Barnabas.
